caption: The drawing consists of a square grid made up of evenly spaced horizontal and vertical pencil lines, forming small squares. Within the central area of the grid, colored segments fill the individual squares, arranged in a checkerboard pattern. The filled squares alternate in color between light blue and red, with short, dense strokes that give a textured appearance to each colored area. The blue and red sections are distributed evenly, though not perfectly symmetrically. The grid extends beyond the colored squares, showing uncolored squares and pencil lines outlining the entire square area. The background is a neutral, slightly textured off-white or beige paper, and there are no other objects or decorations present in the drawing.
title: Textile
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
